notes: The author self-declares a tower obby, so Obby & Platformer leads with its non-negotiable P6, and the shape is course-tower — the answers ask for many floors in a small playable tower, which stacks platforms directly above each other and carries the P2. Adventure is named second because the hidden backstory is real layout work Obby cannot express: discovery alcoves behind fake walls and off-route lore pieces are what 'finding the secret' means spatially, and Obby's own wording for the shared collectible ID is bait coins, so I took the narrative-target reading. The horror flip is the decision I made without a user: the answers say the whole tower turns at once, so it is one build re-dressed in place — lighting, materials and audio swapping over the same geometry — rather than a second map, which keeps it off P4. The top of the tower stays the end of the run and the reward area.
